description: Reference synthetic tag set used by tests/cloud/staging-workflows.mjs to find and remove the fixtures a given run creates. The harness derives its run tag from --run-id (or the default timestamp+random suffix) and reuses the same prefix during cleanup so a partial run never leaves orphan rows behind.
notes: The harness's runTag prefix must be unique per run. Reusing a tag from a previous run that did not clean up will collide; reconcile --run-id values or manually remove leftover fixtures via the budget-api smoke-session CLI reconcile mode.
Bearer tokens are never written to this file. The token file referenced by --budget-token-file is mode 0600 and is unlinked by the harness before exit.

The deeper Budget API workflow (cards → budget / alert-config) is intentionally out of harness scope. See staging-workflows.mjs acceptedLimitations for the documented boundary and follow-up task reference.
